phase_boundary: Each adaptation branch restores exactly the same full normal checkpoint, then begins fresh worlds using the next draws of the saved map RNG, commands delivery, initializes common seed-derived kernel/wait streams and clears history and phase exposure. Parameters, Adam, BatchRenorm, learner RNG, sampler RNG, global update and cumulative environment counters are retained. All branches share new maps and waits, differ only in q. With normal waits0 the parent is already a tick0 world boundary; its just-initialized worlds are replaced by a common next uniform draw. This declared phase reset is not learned-state surgery.
development_evaluation: Pretrain checkpoints: fixed,delay0,mode1/sample8 on all18 development maps. Adaptation checkpoints: fixed/mutant,delay0/12,mode1/sample8 on all18 development maps. Never select weights or tune using these curves. Final-test maps are not passed to model.apply before all20 main jobs finish.
gate: Each of three development seed final checkpoints must have mode success>=0.9 AND sample success>=0.9 on development maps. Mode denominator18; sample denominator144. Equal repeats per map. Failures count0. Exactly all3 complete before judgment; no replacement or automatic retry of scientific failure.
validation: One full512x64 normal update, then uninterrupted/restored next update (3 calls total). From the first smoke checkpoint relabeled global512 solely to exercise schedule plumbing, each q1/q0/q.1 branch one update and its disk-restored repeat (6 calls). Total9 update calls,294912 disposable collector slots. Fixed development18 maps mode+sample8=162 frozen episodes, zero final-test episodes. Exact full-state/metric disk-restore equality, finite values, parameter change and optimizer deltas are mandatory. Smoke checkpoints are never science parents.
training_contract: Uniform train-map draws at world reset only, map RNG independent of action/kernel/delay. Fixed-only normal12 pretrain512 with wait0; delivery adaptation4096 with uniform physical waits0..8 outside history and learner buffers. Same history_mlp architecture and PPO/teacher defaults as spatial_architecture_v1; BC linear global0..4608, no restart. Only completed controlled states/actions populate history. Per-map started/completed episodes,collector slots,valid samples,forced waits,goal command starts and commanded-goal successes are checkpointed. Kernel exposure is separately recorded.
resolved_wait_choice: User explicitly selected normal pretraining0 ticks and adaptation0..8 to retain the historical wait contract. This overrides the earlier ambiguous training_waits description in the policy-blind panel contract without changing any generated map. launch_approval.json pins this decision and execution SHA; learning_contract.json is immutable once learning starts. No long learning without this receipt. The new q100/q0/q10 branches differ only in kernel probability after the common phase reset.
operations: Official server watcher; GPU smoke then development gate, main only after pass. Clean execution SHA and input hashes required, immutable panel hashes validated. Atomic full checkpoints and evaluation hashes; latest complete checkpoint resume with separate attempt journal. SIGTERM/SIGINT checkpoint at update boundary. Technical/numerical/integrity/storage failure writes failed.json and closes autolaunch. Scientific development failure writes development_gate.json with pass=false and closes main, not a technical failed.json. Final completion validates all scheduled artifacts. No checkpoint deletion, no live migration.

retention: Save only at the declared5 pretrain/8 adaptation evaluation updates, plus an interruption boundary when requested. Every64 updates is a capacity CHECK, not a checkpoint save. Retain8pretrains*5=40 plus15adaptations*8=120 and4 validation checkpoints; reserve23 interruption checkpoints and2 publication overlaps:189, rounded to190. No predecessor deletion. Preserved partial writes are included in measured existing bytes; the full190-file additional forecast is conservatively rechecked against free space at every save.
restore_identity: Save each synthetic branch AFTER restoring the same parent and performing the common fresh-world reset/command/kernel/wait/history/exposure initialization, BEFORE its first update. Disk-repeat loads this exact branch without another reset. Replay hash is SHA256 of Flax serialization of device_get(learner states, returned numeric metrics); checkpoint SHA256 hashes state.msgpack bytes separately. Timestamps, paths, journals and wall-clock timing are outside replay-state hashes.
remaining_limits: Wall groups may repeat within a split; disclose group counts. Family and exact length distributions are not matched across gain strata. Do not infer their independent effects. This is within-generator spatial transfer, not universal navigation. Generation feasibility receipt is not a GPU validation receipt.
